senses.gloss: The (thing, person, idea, etc) indicated or understood from context, especially if more remote physically, temporally or mentally than one designated as "this", or if expressing distinction.
The third-person singular neuter personal pronoun used to refer to an inanimate object, abstract entity, or non-human living thing.
A genderless object regarded as masculine, such as certain stars or planets (e.g. Sun, Mercury, Mars, Jupiter) or certain ships.
Indicating a male, usually of an animal.
A single person, previously mentioned, whose gender is unknown, irrelevant, or (since 20th c.) non-binary.
person
plural of that
The name of the Latin script letter O/o.
In all likelihood.
Becoming evident after a relatively long time period.
A lover; a boyfriend or girlfriend.
A male partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.
One who, or that which, achieves assumed goals.
Resulting in success; assuring or promoting success; accomplishing what was proposed; having the desired effect.
Having many accomplishments, often as a result of study or training.
In a happy or cheerful manner; with happiness.
Bottom; more towards the bottom than the middle of an object.
In or to a lower place.
Down the stairs.
Toward a lower level, whether in physical space, in a hierarchy, or in amount or value.
Down a slope.
(informal) The act of landing face first, as a result of an accident or error.
The state of being imprisoned or detained, usually pending a trial.
A bounding straight edge of a two-dimensional shape.
A person or group of people constituting one side in a legal proceeding, such as in a legal action or a contract.
A small handheld device used to remotely control a computerised slide show.
A placeholder name for a person or thing, used when a name is not known; a generic person or thing.
A wish of happiness or safety at parting, especially a permanent departure.
A farewell, the act of departing politely.
(Hinduism) Any of a large body of texts originating in Ancient India. They form the oldest layer of Sanskrit literature and the oldest sacred texts of Hinduism.
The act of parting company.
fine, dry particles
The fine particles which are the result of reducing a dry substance by pounding, grinding, or triturating, or the result of decay; dust.
Any particle that has been removed by a file or similar implement; a shaving.
The cardinal number immediately following forty-three and preceding forty-five.
A reliable, definitive source of information on a subject.
To make a widow or widower of someone; to cause the death of the spouse of.
The act of remembering; a holding in mind, or bringing to mind; recollection.
The act of commemorating; an observance or celebration to honor the memory of some person or event.
The act of recollecting, or recalling to the memory; the act of recalling to memory.
An act of remembering long-past experiences, especially positive or pleasant ones, often fondly.
A sense of evil to come.
Having life; alive.
Having life; living; not dead.
Still in existence; not having disappeared.
That lives.
An amount by which a quantity is increased.
Something secret or unexplainable; an unknown.
Terminating in a point or edge, especially one that can cut or pierce easily; not dull, obtuse, or rounded.
Sharp, barbed; not dull.
Having a sharp point
Having sharp points like needles.
The greatest possible capability, extent, or quantity; maximum.
Largest, greatest (in magnitude), highest, most.
A written law or ordinance passed by a legislative body. [from ca. 1300s]
An edict or law.
The structural elements of a building or other constructed object.
The system that provides support to an organism, internal and made up of bones and cartilage in vertebrates, external in some other animals.
(linguistics) The use of a word, such as a pronoun, to refer to something that must be identified from the wider context; a word used in such a way.

A partly-recognized country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe. Official name: Republic of Kosovo. Capital and largest city: Pristina. Considered by the Republic of Serbia to be one of its two autonomous provinces.
From, of, or pertaining to Kosovo or its people, culture or language.
In a secure manner; without fear or apprehension; without danger.
As can be supported or proven by sound logical deduction, evidence, and precedent, but without absolute certainty.
Unchallenged and accepted without question.
In or to an elevated position.
(television/film, usually, in the plural) Written titles and other information about the TV program or movie shown at the beginning and/or end of the TV program or movie.
Of a procedure, written so as to operate on any data type, the type required being passed as a parameter.
To cause severe suffering to (stronger than to vex but weaker than to torture.)
An item of furniture, often upholstered, for the comfortable seating of more than one person; a sofa.
An upholstered seat with a raised back and one or two raised ends, long enough to comfortably accommodate two or more people.
A couch or sofa-like piece of furniture made of a mattress lying against the wall and on either the floor or an elevated structure.
(UK, Texas) A long seat with a back, made to accommodate several persons at once; a sofa.
An act of something being smuggled.
An increase in the wavelength of a photon or of light, corresponding to a lower frequency and a shift toward the red end of the electromagnetic spectrum.
The state or level of consciousness where sense data can be confirmed by an observer.
awareness
Someone who sells products or services by making unsolicited telephone calls.
(usually, in the plural) Land that is covered mostly with water, with occasional marshy and soggy areas.
To be deplored.
Being overly concerned with formal rules and trivial points of learning, like a pedant.
(mildly, vulgar) An insolent person, especially one who makes snide remarks.
A person who makes an excessive or tedious show of their knowledge, especially regarding rules of vocabulary and grammar.
One who feigns knowledge or cleverness; one who is wisecracking; an insolent upstart.
A member of nomadic Arab tribes dwelling in the desert.
One who enjoys adventures.
An expression of annoyance or impatience.

A necessity or prerequisite; something required or obligatory. Its adpositions are generally of in relation to who or what has given it, on in relation to whom or what it is given to, and for in relation to what is required.
The crime of deliberately starting a fire with intent to cause damage.
The practice of wrapping infants in clothing that restricts movement.
An article of clothing worn over the front of the torso and/or legs for protection from spills; also historically worn by Freemasons and as part of women's fashion.
An item of clothing for people (especially babies) tied around their neck to protect their clothes from getting dirty when eating.
A sleeveless dress, often similar to an apron, generally worn over other clothes, and most often worn by young girls as an overdress.
(board games) A portable surface marked for playing a game, and on which the counters or other pieces are placed and moved.
Soft and easily chewed.
Likely to crunch, especially with reference to food when it is eaten.
The division of a cell nucleus in which the genome is copied and separated into two identical halves. It is normally followed by cell division.
A declaration or remark.
A list of items for various legal purposes, e.g. customs declaration.
A port city and comune, the capital of the Metropolitan City of Genoa and the region of Liguria, Italy.
Drawings or words drawn on a surface in a public place, usually made without authorization.
The exercise of sovereign power.
A mountain range in Italy, stretching 1,200 km from the north to the south of the country, along its east coast, traversing the entire Apennine Peninsula, and often called the "spine of Italy".
(historical) The dynastic name of several Parthian and Armenian kings of the Arsacid dynasty.
Between atoms.
An attractive man, especially one who is muscular.
A weariness caused by exertion; exhaustion.
Lethargy or lack of energy; fatigue, languor, listlessness
A two-masted vessel, square-rigged on both foremast and mainmast
A short, high-pitched sound, as of two objects rubbing together, or the sounds made by mice and other small animals.
(parapsychology) Abbreviation of extrasensory perception.
The act of turning around a centre or an axis.
Resembling or characteristic of the Spanish chivalric hero Don Quixote; possessed with or resulting from the desire to do noble and romantic deeds, without thought of realism and practicality.
(US, Canada, Australia) A house made up of two dwelling units.
an apartment often on two floors
Inflammation of one or more hair follicles.
A machine that mechanically tills the soil.
A tract of scrubland habitats characterised by open, low growing woody vegetation, found on mainly infertile acidic soils. Similar to moorland but with warmer and drier climate.
A former kingdom and autonomous community in northwestern Spain.
A reproductive cell (sperm in males or eggs in females), having only half of a complete set of chromosomes.
The art and science of gems.
Of or pertaining to the larynx.
Very devoted and possibly submissive to one's wife; showing excessive uxorial devotion.
Foreign lands.
the ratio of the probabilities of an event happening to that of it not happening
(mathematics) A number, between 0 and 1, expressing the precise likelihood of an event happening.
Of, relating to, or influenced by climate.
An argot, the jargon of a particular class or subgroup.
Language that is unique to a particular profession or subject; jargon.
A technical terminology unique to a particular subject.
Needlessly obscure or overly technical language.
A class of tetraterpene plant pigments; they vary in colour from yellow, through orange to red, this colour originating in a chain of alternating single and double bonds.
A swimming stroke in which the swimmer lies face down, the arms being swept forward, outward and back under the water and the legs are kicked like a frog's
To contort (a part of the body).
A β-galactosidase enzyme that is involved in the hydrolysis of the disaccharide lactose into constituent galactose and glucose monomers.
(biochemistry) Any of a group of naturally occurring dark pigments, especially the pigment found in skin, hair, fur, and feathers.
Wavering; lacking in commitment, certainty, support, and (often) clarity; namby-pamby.
Having a tendency to fuss, cry, or be bad-tempered/ill-tempered (especially of babies).
One who complains, or is known for their complaints.
(intransitive, uncommon) To make a gloomy, sullen or miserable facial expression; to scowl.
A person who persistently grumbles; a complainer.
To pierce with a lance, or with any similar weapon.
Any microscopic particle less than about 100 nanometers (nm) in diameter.
To form such hardened tissue.
(by extension) The former polity ruling that region.
The sense of smell; the detection of airborne molecules.
The exploration and scientific study of the oceans and ocean floor.
To break from internal pressure.
To fly apart with sudden violent force; to blow up, to burst, to detonate, to go off.
The owner or operator of a retail business.
The state of being colorful.
An independent city in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany.
A classical Indo-European language of South Asia, which is the liturgical language of Hinduism, Buddhism, Sikhism, Jainism.
Somewhat yellow in colour.
One of the component states of Germany according to the current administrative division of the nation.
Of or pertaining to the majority ethnic group of Sri Lanka, their Indo-Aryan language, or their culture.
A town and municipality in the easternmost part of Republika Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, which was the site of an ethnic cleansing massacre in July 1995.

A group, sect or movement following an unorthodox religious or philosophical system of beliefs, especially one in which members remove and exclude themselves from greater society, including family members not part of the cult, and show extreme devotion to a charismatic leader.
A subarctic zone of evergreen coniferous forests situated south of the tundras and north of the steppes in the Northern Hemisphere.
(historical) an ancient Xianbei tribe of China
A person who is in charge of the controls of an aircraft.
An ardent desire, especially sexual desire; lust.
A sharp double bend on a racecourse, designed to prevent unsafe speeds; an obstacle creating a curve.
(uncountable) Deception by the use of trickery, quibbling, or subterfuge.
In a hurried manner.
